Youkai Rabbit.name: Youkai Rabbit
Youkai Rabbit.description: Even as a youkai, they still like fresh and sweet food. How cute! Of course, it's impossible for a youkai to have a meal without meat. Oh well, at least they're still cute, even when eating meat~

Youkai Cat.name: Youkai Cat
Youkai Cat.description: A youkai cat. Hard to misidentify them because they have two tails. Supposedly, stronger nekomata have tails further apart. They look cute, but they're actually mean, fierce, and aggressive! In Gensokyo, even wild cats are picky eaters.

Youkai Tanuki.name: Youkai Tanuki
Youkai Tanuki.description: A short-tempered youkai who always acts as if they are better than everyone else. In reality, they're not strong enough to back up their stance. However, tanukis are very good at tricks and disguises. Beware, they may pay their bill with leaves!

Youkai Fox.name: Youkai Fox
Youkai Fox.description: They often talk as if they know everything. Feels like they're just bragging about their old age and ego. That said, sometimes their advice is actually pretty useful. Maybe they really did learn a thing or two given their long life span.

Youkai Snake.name: Youkai Snake
Youkai Snake.description: Supposedly an ancient monster... Well, the key word is "ancient". They are no longer the fearsome monsters now. Just be careful about them dining and dashing...

Human Child.name: Human Child
Human Child.description: Noisy tiny human brats. Creatures like this used to be my... well, after spending some time with them, they're actually not as bad as I first thought. Their smiles can easily erase my fatigue, it's almost magical.

Human Male.name: Human Male
Human Male.description: There's nothing extraordinary about him. He's always talking to himself, and complains a lot when he's drunk. Nevertheless, I heard that human males are usually the strongest in their species and are often relied on by others.

Human Female.name: Human Female
Human Female.description: If they are in a group, then they will go on and on and on, chatting about their trivial daily life or complimenting each other on dresses, and jewels. However, occasionally they share cooking techniques or new recipes. I'm not going to complain about that, of course.

Human Elder.name: Human Elder
Human Elder.description: A human senior who has merely lived for a few decades, a fraction of a normal youkai's life span. However, I can sense a faint sage aura coming from some of them... Might not be a bad idea to follow their suggestions once in a while.

Saemon.name: Saemon
Saemon.description: They are supposedly famous food critics among humans. They would even travel far and wide in search of great food... It's tough for humans to stay alive already. Oh well, I'll satisfy their stomach~

Zashiki-warashi.name: Zashiki-warashi
Zashiki-warashi.description: I previously thought that zashiki-warashi were earthbound and unable to go elsewhere, but that's actually a mistaken belief. It seems that they can attach themselves to an object and travel anywhere. Oh, there's also a rumor saying that this youkai can make the host lucky. At least I hope its's true.

Kappa.name: Kappa
Kappa.description: Kappa in legends are just good swimmers. However, in Gensokyo, they're also excellent businessmen. I should ask one to be my mentor. You can frequently see them thinking and writing and completely ignoring their surrounding environment... It's quite charming and interesting, actually

Goblin.name: Goblin
Goblin.description: These customers give me a little bit of a headache. They're cautious but kind of ugly, and sometimes frighten human guests. It makes no sense to me as humans get along pretty well with other youkai dining here...

Tengu.name: Tengu
Tengu.description: They're polite, but pretty persistent. Well, at least those tengu that visit my izakaya. I have a hard time dealing with them, but they're my customers in the end. I'll do my best to make them happy!

Fairy.name: Fairy
Fairy.description: Actually, fairies don't have to eat. They're simply imitating others. They love anything fun and play pranks on others. Beware of their traps!

White Wolf Tengu.name: White Wolf Tengu
White Wolf Tengu.description: Tengu society has a strict hierarchy with the whtie wolf tengu acting as the mountain guards. It's probably because of their duties that most of them have a strict personality. However, sometimes they drink too much and end up a little too chatty.

Yamanba.name: Yamanba
Yamanba.description: A solitary youkai race that live in the Youkai Mountain but barely communicate even among themselves. Rumor says they capture wandering children lost in the mountains... but that's a misunderstanding. While they may speak harshly, it's just because they aren't good with words. In fact, they are very straightforward and kind.

Yamawaro.name: Yamawaro
Yamawaro.description: A kappa who abandoned the river in favor of the peak of Youkai Mountain. They establish base camps and are experts on the mountain. Their research in economics is particularly advanced. I have no idea what they mean by private equity, merger and acquisition, or capital market... that's beyond me...

Magician.name: Magician
Magician.description: The mushrooms in the Forest of Magic can help to concentrate magical power, so many magicians live there. Most of them live alone like hermits. I guess magic itself is a lonely thing~

Forest Fairy.name: Forest Fairy
Forest Fairy.description: The more fairies there are, the more natural an environment is. The Forest of Magic is rich in all kinds of resources partially thanks to all the fairies living there. It is said that every tree is home to a fairy. Some fairies like to play pranks, so be careful around trees.

Lost Doll.name: Lost Doll
Lost Doll.description: A doll of unknown origin. As of yet, I'm not sure if she's a tsukumogami. After all, there is a magician living in the forest who can manipulate dolls... but she doesn't really look like she's being manipulated. I guess she must be a tsukumogami, right?

Tsuchigumo.name: Tsuchigumo
Tsuchigumo.description: Tsuchigumo are spiders lurking in the Dark Blowhole. They're a bit of a peculiar bunch, but they're very passionate about architecture. They even frequently discuss problems related to architecture among each other. Maybe I can learn something too.

Oni.name: Oni
Oni.description: A legendary race of youkai said to have existed long before ancient times! It's said that they're the strongest race in Gensokyo, but in reality they've left a long time ago. I never imagined they'd be living in the Underworld. Most oni are pretty straightforward, but they're also really fierce, so absolutely never lie in front of them!

Hone-onna.name: Hone-onna
Hone-onna.description: They're all really pretty! These ladies handle themselves in a gentle and mature way, carrying a lantern decorate with peonies wherever they go. They can supposedly charm passing humans, though every time I ran into one at the cave they'd help illuminate the path ahead for me.

Hell Raven.name: Hell Raven
Hell Raven.description: Hell ravens reside in the lowest level of hell. While most youkai in Former Hell moved there due to their original homes becoming defunct, hell ravens have always been living in hell, making them the earliest residents here.

Ubume.name: Ubume
Ubume.description: Legends say ubume become birds when wearing their feathers, and become young girls when not. They can read people's fortune by collecting their fingernails, so most of them work as fortune tellers. They always speak in riddles, probably because they want to maintaintheir mystique.

Youkai Leopard.name: Youkai Leopard
Youkai Leopard.description: Fierce and ferocious. Stubborn yet candid. Due to my natural instincts, I'm a tiny bit afraid of them... although, while leopards are powerful by nature, there aren't many that manage to become youkai.

Monk.name: Monk
Monk.description: Humans might not understand, but I know... the monks training at Myouren Temple are mostly youkai. They do engage in some Buddhist training like the six perfections, but no one has observed any results. A lot of youkai still do whatever they want outside of training.

Youkai Mouse.name: Youkai Mouse
Youkai Mouse.description: The treasure hunters you'll find everywhere in Gensokyo. Befriend them and you'll never have to worry about losing anything again. Though if you ask them to find food, they might eat it all before they even return it to you.

Hachishaku-sama.name: Hachishaku-sama
Hachishaku-sama.description: An eight-feet tall monster. Their skin is very pale due to wearing a sombrero all the time. They used to love wearing a white one-piece dress too, resulting in them becoming unnoticed during the day and their entire race had to starve, which is why they're as thin as a rake. Now, some of the more progressive ones are looking for more eye-catching attire.

Taoist.name: Taoist
Taoist.description: Many in the Divine Spirit Mausoleum worship Miko as their teacher, hoping to learn hermit arts. They seem to only be used for miscellaneous tasks though. They all look determined and full of ambition... so maybe doing miscellaneous tasks is also an interesting job?

Jiangshi.name: Jiangshi
Jiangshi.description: Undead controlled by a wicked hermit. They're corpses, but they won't decompose, being stronger than they were while alive. Their brains are no-good, so communicating with them is very hard. At least they aren't picky about food. Apparently humans temporarily turn into them if they get bitten by one, which I think is pretty interesting. It's kind of like a Jiangshi demo?

Hermit.name: Hermit
Hermit.description: Humans who, through years of training, gained abilities surpassing that of a normal human. A delicacy for many youkai, their life could be said to be one of peril. Their harsh life is probably why all of them have weird personalities...

Inchling.name: Inchling
Inchling.description: Legends say they're the descendants of Sukuna-bikona, with bodies only the size of an inch. Having stayed in the castle all their lives, a lack of common sense is the norm among them. However, they possess a strong thirst for knowledge and are very eager to explore the world outside.

Delinquent Boy.name: Delinquent Boy
Delinquent Boy.description: Boys from all around Gensokyo lured in by Seija. Most if not all of them are young men uncertain about their future, following Seija out of zeal for her "grand design", but now they seem even more uncertain...

Delinquent Girl.name: Delinquent Girl
Delinquent Girl.description: Girls from all around Gensokyo lured in by Seija. Most if not all of them are young women uncertain about their future, following Seija out of zeal for her "grand design", but now they seem even more uncertain...

Toy Soldier.name: Toy Soldier
Toy Soldier.description: Toys that have come alive because of the miracle mallet's magic. Due to an unknown person, the magic in their bodies that should've gone back to the mallet have been converted into their own magic, thus giving them true lives.

Convalla Fairy.name: Convalla Fairy
Convalla Fairy.description: Fairies living in lilies-of-the-valley. Spends every day attempting to answer the question of "Who on earth is this 'Lily' Miss Medicine talks about?" The bounty has already reached 99 "world's roundest rocks", but the mystery still remains unsolved.

Sunflower Fairy.name: Sunflower Fairy
Sunflower Fairy.description: Fairies living in sunflowers. Some say these fairies sneakily adjust a sunflower's position, hence why sunflowers always face towards the sun. This ultimate technique of theirs have already fooled countless humans, and is what they take pride in.

Rose Fairy.name: Rose Fairy
Rose Fairy.description: Fairies living in roses. They heard from somewhere that the rose is a certain planet's one-of-a-kind, most cared-for flower, starting a craze of moving house among them. Not a single fairy has succeeded yet.

Kage-onna.name: Kage-onna
Kage-onna.description: A spirit somewhere between a phantom and a vengeful spirit. Apparently they harbored hatred when they passed away, so they love playing pranks on humans. If you ever see the shadow of a person walking around the house at night, yet you can't find anyone, it's the doing of the kage-onna. They look a bit gloomy, but that's just an act.

Poker Soldier.name: Poker Soldier
Poker Soldier.description: A poker card figure formed from the Makai creator's magic. Honest to the point of being mute, they are very self-conscious at patrolling even when work is not assigned. They're also always expecting someone to fall out of the sky, seems to be related to some rabbit hole story?

Clown.name: Clown
Clown.description: A poker card figure formed from the Makai creator's magic, who takes up a position similar to that of a soldier commander. Not only do they lack the demeanor of an officer, they don't even have jobs to assign to the soldiers. Wandering around Makai all day, they looks more like a street performer than a soldier commander.

Mad Cap.name: Mad Cap
Mad Cap.description: Craftsman who excels in making hats and tailoring. Words have it that because they need mercury to preserve non-woven cloth for making hats, they often go into spasm or sometimes even hallucinate from mercury poisoning; thus, they are called Mad Caps. But I understand, below the cover of madness is their passion and persistence to their own work.

Lunarian.name: Lunarian
Lunarian.description: Humans living in the Lunar Capital. They gave up their lifespan, and dedicated themselves to remove impurity and get rid of death. But they aren't immortal, as they can still die from accidents or warfares, meaning they still have a tiny bit of impurity on them.

Medicine-Pounding Rabbit.name: Medicine-Pounding Rabbit
Medicine-Pounding Rabbit.description: Moon rabbits responsible for pounding medicine. It looks like they're pounding rice cake, but it was in fact medicine in the mortar. Their act of pounding medicine was not for making valuable medicine, but for redeeming someone's sins. Because they're constantly repeating vain-looking labor, they accumulated quite a lot of fatigue.

Lunar Emissary.name: Lunar Emissary
Lunar Emissary.description: Moon rabbits responsible for guarding the Lunar Capital. Lunar Emissaries, compared to other moon rabbits' jobs, is relatively more disciplined. In order to ensure they can engage in war with Earthen humans in critical moments, they need to undergo strict training, which isn't easy.
